title: Goodreads reviewer Esben — 'Eric's new book makes you feel like capitalism can work for the people again, separating from the madness of the markets'
summary: Esben's Goodreads review distills Incorruptible's emotional payoff in two lines — hope that capitalism can serve people again, and a personal bullish bet on the mission Eric is laying out.
blockquote: Eric's new book makes you feel like capitalism can work for the people again, separating from the madness of the markets. I am very bullish on this mission.
